known_gaps: PsyQA is gated and excluded; supply --psyqa-local if access is granted.
The VAD service runs and is health-checked but the frontend never opens its socket; voice mode is manual push-to-talk.
Voice chat has not been exercised end to end with real audio.
Reply quality is bounded by TinyLlama-1.1B at one epoch; a 6 GB card caps the base model size.
Conversations are stored unencrypted in SQLite with no retention limit.
Model server runs CPU torch by default; docker-compose.gpu.yml is required for usable latency.
notes: Every stage from build to first chat message surfaced defects that static review had missed.
Crisis detection missed inflected phrasing such as 'ending my life' until it was tested against the running stack.
Model output is suppressed entirely on a crisis disclosure; only reviewed text is returned.
